panel.title: SEO
panel.preview.no_description: No meta description — the search engine will pick one.
panel.social.hint: Leave empty to reuse the SEO title and description.
panel.social.title: Title when shared
panel.social.image.placeholder: Uses the record or shop default
panel.advanced.noindex: Hide this page from search engines (noindex)
panel.advanced.nofollow: Don't follow links on this page (nofollow)
panel.advanced.canonical.help: Only fill this in if this page duplicates another.
panel.unsaved: These settings are saved along with the record.
panel.error: The SEO panel failed to render. Details in the console.
settings.heading: Make every search result earn its click
settings.summary: Set the defaults that shape how your shop appears in search, social shares, and structured data. Product-level changes stay available in each editor.
settings.general.title: Name your shop consistently
settings.general.description: These defaults appear across titles, social cards, and structured data when a page has no more specific value.
settings.site_name.help: Used by %%sitename%%. Defaults to the domain.
settings.tagline.help: Used by %%tagline%% — mostly on the home page.
settings.separator.help: The character between the parts of a title.
settings.organization_name.help: For structured data. Defaults to the shop name.
settings.templates.intro: These templates apply to every record. Each product, collection or page can then be customised individually from its own screen.
settings.templates.title: Start with sensible titles and descriptions
settings.variables.note: An empty variable takes its preceding separator with it — no orphan “·”.
settings.var.title: The product, collection or page name
settings.noindex_filtered_listings.help: Every filter combination is a near-duplicate of the collection. Recommended.
settings.noindex_account: Don't index account, tracking and thank-you pages
settings.indexing.title: Keep low-value pages out of search
settings.indexing.description: These pages remain usable for visitors. The controls only tell search engines which URLs should not become search results.
settings.schema.title: Structured data
settings.schema.description: Help search engines understand your shop, products, ratings, and breadcrumb trail.
settings.twitter_site.help: Without the @ — it will be added.
settings.social_image_id.help: Used when a record has no image of its own.
settings.social.title: Control shared links
settings.social.description: Use a default image and account identity when a product or page does not provide its own social content. Media IDs come from the media library.
settings.sitemap.title: Give crawlers a clean map of your shop
settings.sitemap.description: The sitemap updates after catalogue changes and omits pages marked noindex.
settings.robots_extra.help: Appended after the default rules. One directive per line.
analysis.keyphrase.missing: No focus keyphrase set. Add one to analyse this page.
analysis.keyphrase_title.absent: The focus keyphrase is not in the SEO title.
analysis.keyphrase_title.late: The keyphrase is in the title but near the end. Move it closer to the start.
analysis.keyphrase_title.good: The focus keyphrase opens the SEO title.
analysis.keyphrase_description.no_descri: No meta description — the search engine will write one for you.
analysis.keyphrase_description.good: The focus keyphrase appears in the meta description.
analysis.keyphrase_description.absent: The focus keyphrase is not in the meta description.
analysis.keyphrase_handle.absent: The focus keyphrase does not appear in the URL.
analysis.keyphrase_handle.good: The focus keyphrase appears in the URL.
analysis.keyphrase_handle.partial: The URL contains only part of the focus keyphrase.
analysis.keyphrase_content.good: The focus keyphrase appears in the description.
analysis.keyphrase_content.absent: The focus keyphrase does not appear in the product description.
analysis.density.unmeasurable: Not enough text to measure density.
analysis.density.stuffed: Keyphrase repeated {{occurrences}} times ({{density}}%) — that reads as stuffing.
analysis.density.thin: Keyphrase used {{occurrences}} times ({{density}}%) — a little more would help.
analysis.title_length.long: Title too long ({{length}} characters) — it will be cut off in results.
analysis.title_length.short: Short title ({{length}} characters) — you have room to spare.
analysis.description_length.long: Meta description too long ({{length}}) — it will be cut off.
analysis.content_length.short: Word count: {{words}} — a little short, aim for {{target}}.
analysis.content_length.thin: Word count: {{words}} — too little to rank well.
analysis.sentence_length.bad: {{share}}% long sentences — the text is hard to read.
analysis.paragraph_length.long: Very long paragraphs: {{paragraphs}} — break them up.
analysis.transitions.good: {{share}}% of sentences use a transition word.
analysis.transitions.ok: {{share}}% transition words — a few more would help it flow.
analysis.transitions.bad: {{share}}% transition words — the text feels choppy.
